The '''Provisional Council of the Alliance of Free Planets''' was the interim governing body of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] during the transition to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Provisional Council had an extremely short lifespan, existing during the time when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] reorganized itself into the New Republic. During this time, the Provisional Council released the [[Declaration of the Alliance of Free Planets]], a document that was followed only four weeks later by the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]].

Members of the Provisional Council included [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Kerrithrarr/Legends|Kerrithrarr]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Doman Beruss (Corellian)|Doman Beruss]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Jenssar SoBilles]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], [[Borsk Fey'lya]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], [[Verrinnefra B'thog Indriummsegh]] of [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], and [[Sian Tevv/Legends|Sian Tevv]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. There were also members of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] and [[Sedrian]] species on the Council.
